audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer names Gangplank's W as 'Trial by Fire' in two places. Trial by Fire is his PASSIVE; the W is Remove Scurvy. No cooldown was attached to the cleanse anywhere, and Cannon Barrage's true damage was never stated.
audit.why: Riot data: P Trial by Fire (on-hit burn), W Remove Scurvy 22/20/18/16/14s, heals and cures CC. That W is the entire reason Garen's Decisive Strike silence/slow does not stick, so its cooldown is the trade calendar. Cannon Barrage carries trueDamage, so stacking armour against him is the wrong answer.
audit.corrected: Remove Scurvy named with its 22s rank-1 cooldown in mid, spikes[2], report[5] and wants.foe[0]; the true-damage point written into Common Mistakes.

audit.why: 50.8% over 4240 games with Garen L1-L2 and L4-5, Skill at L3 and L6, Gangplank at 2+ items is coherent with diff TRICKY / 5/10 and carry 8/10. Mirror recorded the chart left as-is; I moved nothing.

audit.whatIsWrong: Focus and do's pointed at a placeholder string, 'GP powder barrels and citrus orange cleanse'.
audit.why: The real tracked spikes are Powder Keg (E) charge count and Remove Scurvy (W) at 22/20/18/16/14s. Garen's own are Decisive Strike at a flat 8s and Courage at 22/19.5/17/14.5/12s.
audit.corrected: focus.text and dosFull[0].t/[2].d now name Powder Keg (E) and Remove Scurvy (W).

audit.why: The punishable window is Remove Scurvy's 22 seconds at rank 1 — with it down, the Q silence and slow hold and the run-down completes.
audit.corrected: 'Commit while that W is down' written into mid, plus the 22s figure in spikes[2] and report[5].

audit.whatIsWrong: No Grievous Wounds timing, and no warning against raw armour.
audit.why: Remove Scurvy is a heal, so anti-heal changes extended trades; Cannon Barrage is true damage, so armour does not answer it.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds added to spikes[2]; 'buy health, not raw armour' added to Common Mistakes.

edits.before: Skill check - his barrel chains and Trial by Fire (W) cleanse start to out-poke and out-scale your trades if he plays it clean, but a fed you can still burst him.
edits.after: Skill check - his barrel chains and Remove Scurvy (W) start to out-poke you, and it cleanses on a 22s rank 1 cooldown, so trade in that window; Grievous Wounds cuts the heal.

edits.before: Levels 3-5 you stay ahead, but from 6 it tips into a skill matchup. His R Cannon Barrage buys disengage and his W Trial by Fire cleanses your Q silence and slow, so a sharp GP kites your all-in with barrel chains. Kill him before then; if you can't reach him, deny setup and force him to farm under tower.
edits.after: Levels 3-5 you stay ahead, but from 6 it tips into a skill matchup. His R Cannon Barrage buys disengage and Remove Scurvy (W) cleanses your Q silence and slow on a 22s cooldown at rank 1, so a sharp GP kites your all-in with barrel chains. Commit while that W is down; otherwise deny his keg setup and force him to farm under tower.

edits.before: Enemy misses or wastes GP powder barrels and citrus orange cleanse; Garen immediately Q sprints forward, silences them, executes a full Judgment spin loop to shred their armor, and drops Demacian Justice for an easy kill.
edits.after: He burns Remove Scurvy or has no keg placed: Decisive Strike (Q) in on the move-speed burst, silence him so Parrrley cannot fire, spin Judgment (E) through him, and close with Demacian Justice's true-damage execute.

edits.before: Forcing a fight before his punish tool is gone is the #1 way you throw a winning lane.
edits.after: Cannon Barrage is global — sitting low HP anywhere on the map is a choice, not a default.

notes: 'Trial by Fire (W)' was a genuine wrong-name error of the calibration type — it is the passive, not the W. Whether Garen's Courage tenacity or Remove Scurvy's cleanse interacts with the Decisive Strike silence in any special way is not answerable from the kit files; I only stated that the cleanse removes the silence/slow, which follows directly from Riot's text.
